title: Viral Hybrid
lines: The overall strength of the Viral Hybrid is perfect for medium to light oil patterns.
The 2000 Abralon TM polished finish of the Viral Hybrid provides easy length on almost any lane condition.
When looking for consistent performance, Hammer fans love the Vibe Core. This one is a proven winner.
This Hybrid version of our Violent Flip Reactive cover allows the Viral Hybrid to fit right between the Viral Pearl and Viral Solid in overall hook potential.
FACTORY FINISH 500/2000 Abralon® Polished w/ Powerhouse™ Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Light Oil
